product.html.title: Product
product.html.body:
Product
Purpose
WithinTech Learn helps program participants build practical skills through structured courses, quizzes, certificates, and coding challenges.
Users



User
Goal




Visitor
Browse courses, challenges, stats, and legal pages.


Student
Enroll, learn, take quizzes, solve challenges, pay, and download certificates.


Admin
Manage content, users, enrollments, payments, analytics, and invitations.



Core Journey

Visitor signs up or accepts an invitation.
Student verifies email and signs in.
Student browses courses or challenges.
Student enrolls or pays when required.
Student completes lessons, modules, quizzes, or code challenges.
Student earns progress, score, and certificates.
Admin monitors usage and improves content.

Product Rules

Courses can be draft, published, or archived.
Course access can be free, paid for course access, or paid for certificate.
Quizzes can live at course, module, or lesson level.
Certificates are unique per student and course.
Challenges use hidden and visible test cases.
Admin routes require authentication and admin role.

workflows.html.title: Workflows
workflows.html.body:
Workflows
Student Enrollment

Student signs up, verifies email, or accepts an invitation.
Student opens a published course.
Free courses can be enrolled directly.
Paid courses go through checkout and Xentripay.
API creates or updates StudentCourse.
Web redirects into /learn/courses/[slug].

Course Completion

Student reads module and lesson content.
Web calls progress endpoints for lessons and modules.
Course quiz becomes available when required content is complete.
Passing quiz updates progress and can create certificate eligibility.
Certificate record is unique per user and course.

Challenge Submission

Student opens /learn/challenges/[slug].
Web sends language and code to student challenge submit route.
API loads challenge, starter metadata, and test cases.
Executor sends code to Judge0.
API stores ChallengeSubmission.
Accepted submissions create ChallengeProgress and update score.

Admin Content Publishing

Admin creates a course in draft.
Admin adds modules, lessons, blocks, and quizzes.
Admin uploads images when content needs media.
Admin publishes the course.
Public and student course lists can show the course.

Student Import

Admin uploads .xlsx, .xls, or .csv.
API accepts up to 500 rows and 10MB.
Required fields are first name, last name, and email.
API creates students and reports created, skipped, and failed rows.

Payment

Web calls /payments/initiate.
API creates a Payment with Xentripay reference.
Student completes provider flow.
Web checks /payments/status/:txId.
Paid course access or certificate access is unlocked.

architecture.html.title: Architecture
architecture.html.body:
Architecture
Repo Layout



Path
Responsibility




apps/web
Next.js UI, app routes, components, hooks, API client.


apps/api
Express API, Prisma, routes, services, middleware, templates.


apps/executor
Small Go service for challenge execution through Judge0.


packages/shared
Shared schemas, types, and role constants.


infra
Nginx, PostgreSQL init, and backup scripts.


docs
GitBook documentation.



Runtime Boundaries

Web calls API through NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL.
API owns auth, database writes, payments, emails, uploads, scoring, and certificates.
Executor owns code execution requests only.
Judge0 runs isolated from the app database and app Redis.
Nginx terminates HTTPS and routes frontend and API domains.

Main Flows



Flow
Path




Public browse
Browser -> Web -> API public routes -> PostgreSQL/Redis


Student course
Browser -> Web protected route -> API student routes -> PostgreSQL


Payment
Browser -> API payments -> Xentripay -> Payment row/status


Upload
Browser -> API upload middleware -> S3-compatible storage -> storage key in DB


Challenge run
Browser -> API challenge route -> Executor -> Judge0 -> API response/submission


Admin edit
Browser -> Admin route -> API admin route -> Prisma transaction



Auth Shape

API uses cookies and JWT access/refresh tokens.
Web calls API with credentials: "include".
Failed protected calls attempt refresh once, then redirect to sign in.
Admin access is enforced by authenticate and isAdmin middleware.

data-model.html.title: Data Model
data-model.html.body:
Data Model
Main Entities



Entity
Meaning




User
Student or admin account. Stores auth state, score, OTP, and profile data.


Role
Role lookup used by users.


Course
Learning product with status, pricing, modules, quiz, enrollments, payments, certificates.


Module
Ordered course section. Can contain blocks, lessons, quiz, and progress.


Lesson
Ordered module content. Can contain blocks, quiz, and progress.


Quiz
Assessment attached to a course, module, or lesson.


Question
Ordered quiz question.


QuestionOption
Answer choice with correctness flag.


StudentCourse
Enrollment join table with status.


Certificate
Completion proof for a user and course.


Payment
Xentripay payment record for course access or certificate.


Challenge
Coding challenge with starter code, signature metadata, and test cases.


ChallengeSubmission
User code result for a challenge.


ChallengeProgress
Completion marker for a challenge.



Important Constraints

User.email, Course.slug, Challenge.slug, and Payment.xentripayRefId are unique.
Course/module/lesson order uses orderIndex.
Module and lesson blocks are unique by parent and orderIndex.
Certificate is unique by user and course.
Challenge progress is unique by user and challenge.

Progress Records



Record
Created when




LessonProgress
Student completes a lesson.


ModuleProgress
Student completes a module.


StudentCourse.status = PASSED
Student satisfies course completion rules.


Certificate
Student earns course proof of completion.


ChallengeProgress
Student gets an accepted challenge submission.



Status Enums



Enum
Values




Course status
draft, published, archived


Course access
FREE, PAID_COURSE, PAID_CERTIFICATE


Enrollment
PENDING, ENROLLED, PASSED


Payment
PENDING, PAID, FAILED, EXPIRED


Challenge
draft, published


Submission
accepted, wrong_answer, time_limit_exceeded, runtime_error, compile_error

api.html.title: API
api.html.body:
API
Shape
The API is an Express app in apps/api. Routes are grouped by audience:



Group
Purpose




Public
Courses, challenges, and stats.


Auth
Login, refresh, verification, reset, signup, Google auth.


Student
Enrollments, course progress, quizzes, challenges, certificates.


Admin
Content, users, enrollments, analytics, challenges, invitations.


Payments
Xentripay payment creation, status, and callbacks.



Middleware

helmet, cors, cookieParser, JSON body parsing, compression, and request logging.
Route-specific rate limits for login, password reset, and quiz attempts.
authenticate protects student and admin routes.
isAdmin protects admin routes.
Validation middleware uses Zod schemas.
Upload middleware handles file inputs.

Services



Service
Responsibility




Course/challenge cache
Cache public and repeated reads with Redis.


Storage
S3-compatible uploads and signed access.


Email
SMTP delivery for OTP, invites, welcomes, and receipts.


Xentripay
Payment provider integration.


Scoring
User score and completion calculations.



Response Contract
Most API responses use:
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Done",
  "data": {}
}

Expected failures return the same shape with success: false and an HTTP status that matches the error.
Route Protection



Route group
Protection




/public/*
Open.


/auth/login, /auth/signup, reset, verify
Open with validation and rate limits where needed.


/auth/profile, change password
Authenticated.


/student/*
Authenticated student/admin session.


/admin/*
Authenticated admin only.


/payments/initiate, /payments/status/:txId
Authenticated.


/admin/payments
Authenticated admin only.



API Docs

Swagger UI: /docs
Raw OpenAPI JSON: /docs-json
Liveness: /health
Readiness: /health/full

security.html.title: Security
security.html.body:
Security
Access Control



Area
Control




Student pages
Web redirects unauthenticated users to sign in.


Admin pages
Web redirects non-admin users to learn area.


Student API
authenticate middleware.


Admin API
authenticate plus isAdmin.


Cookies
API uses credentialed requests and refresh flow.



Request Safety

Zod validates request bodies and important query strings.
Login, password reset, and quiz attempts have rate limits.
File uploads use multer limits and image-specific middleware.
Student imports accept .xlsx, .xls, and .csv, capped at 10MB and 500 rows.
API uses helmet, CORS allowlist, JSON parsing, compression, and request logging.

Sensitive Areas



Area
Notes




JWT secrets
Must be unique per environment.


OTP
Stored on user with purpose and expiry.


Payments
Store provider reference and status, not provider secrets in code.


Challenge tests
Hidden tests should not appear in public responses.


Judge0
Runs isolated with its own database and Redis.


Storage
Store object keys in DB; keep credentials in env.



Operational Rules

Do not commit .env.
Do not expose hidden challenge test cases.
Do not bypass API permission checks from the web.
Confirm /health/full after deployment.
Rotate secrets if logs or screenshots leak them.

scaling.html.title: Scaling
scaling.html.body:
Scaling
Current Shape
The platform is built for a single VPS running Docker Compose. This keeps operations simple while the product is still compact.
Bottlenecks To Watch



Area
Risk
Response




API
CPU or request latency
Run more API containers behind Nginx.


Web
Page render pressure
Scale Next.js containers separately.


Database
Slow queries or locks
Add indexes, tune queries, move to managed Postgres.


Redis
Cache misses or memory pressure
Set TTLs, monitor memory, move to managed Redis.


Executor
Code submission bursts
Scale executor and Judge0 workers.


Storage
Large media growth
Keep files in S3-compatible storage, not containers.


Email
Delivery limits
Use provider quotas and retry strategy.



Keep Simple Until Needed
Do not add queues, Kubernetes, or microservices unless traffic or reliability data asks for them.
Scaling Order

Fix slow queries and missing indexes.
Cache public course/challenge reads.
Scale API and web containers separately.
Scale executor and Judge0 workers for challenge bursts.
Move PostgreSQL and Redis to managed services.
Add queues for email, payments, certificates, and scoring.
Consider orchestration only when Compose becomes the bottleneck.

Submit one coding challenge.
Test one payment path in provider sandbox or staging.

Troubleshooting



Symptom
Check




Web cannot reach API
NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL, CORS APP_URL, API container health.


Login loops
Refresh cookie, JWT secrets, browser credentials mode.


Course missing publicly
Course status must be published.


Upload fails

Executor URL, Judge0 URL, Judge0 worker health.

Xentripay reference, provider status endpoint, Payment.status.


Certificate missing
Course completion, quiz pass status, certificate uniqueness.

code-style.html.title: Code Style
code-style.html.body:
Code Style
General

Prefer TypeScript types from packages/shared when both web and API need the same shape.
Keep route files thin; put business logic in services.
Use Zod schemas for request validation.
Use Prisma for database access.
Keep naming domain-first: course, module, lesson, quiz, challenge, enrollment, certificate.
Avoid unrelated refactors inside feature work.
Prefer small, local changes over broad rewrites.
Keep user-facing copy clear and direct.

Web

Use the Next.js App Router.
Keep screens in apps/web/app.
Keep reusable UI in apps/web/components.
Keep API calls and cache hooks in apps/web/lib and apps/web/hooks.
Use TanStack Query for server state.
Use shared UI primitives before adding new one-off controls.

API

Group routes by audience: public, auth, student, admin, payments.
Validate input before service calls.
Return consistent response objects with success, message, and optional data.
Throw AppError for expected failures.
Capture unexpected errors with Sentry.

Database

Add migrations for schema changes.
Preserve cascade behavior intentionally.
Index fields used for filtering, lookup, and dashboards.
Keep unique constraints close to product rules.

Docs

Keep pages short.
Put operational commands in code blocks.
Update SUMMARY.md when adding a page.
Favor tables, diagrams, and lists when they reduce explanation.

File Patterns



Need
Where to put it




Public web page
apps/web/app/.../page.tsx


Shared UI
apps/web/components/ui


Feature component
nearest components folder


API route
apps/api/src/routes/


API service
next to the route file


Request schema
route area *.schemas.ts


Database change
Prisma schema plus migration


Shared type/schema
packages/shared/src


Email template
apps/api/src/templates
